selection_scope: 14 primary research papers: electronic altermagnetism/twist/moiré intersections, magnetic texture controls, bosonic and peripheral method comparisons.
history_scope: Original daily TB literature index (local history, through 2026-11-03)
Continuation daily TB index (117 entries, through 2026-11-07)
Prior NiCl2 angle-study manuscript and supplement (2026-11-06)
dedup_method: Case-folded DOI/arXiv aliases plus normalized full/partial titles and explicit search of repo literature docs. New means absent from these checked records only, not a guarantee the user never saw it. Duplicate source versions are merged into a paper record. Sheng is already documented in repo even though not matched in daily index.

metadata_corrections.old: González-Hernández 等，Nano Lett. 6c01391 (as lead author shorthand)
metadata_corrections.correct: Alberto M. Ruiz et al.; authors Ruiz, Shumilin, González-Hernández, Baldoví

metadata_corrections.old: Guo, Liu, Liu used without source-version distinction
metadata_corrections.correct: Journal authors: San-Dong Guo, Yichen Liu, Junxi Yu, Cheng-Cheng Liu; arXiv v1 has three authors and is the model formula source

papers.title: Altermagnetism and strain induced altermagnetic transition in Cairo pentagonal monolayer
papers.read_depth: journal metadata/abstract; arXiv supplement S5-S7 inspected
papers.summary_zh: Cairo 六位点模型保留两磁性、四非磁性位点；对角应变改变 g/d 波节点。可将当日日报模型整理为独立预设，并校验未应变节点及应变后的低阶分量。
papers.implementation_scope: 单层电子 TB；可作为扭转前的微观输入，论文自身并非 moiré 超胞。

papers.title: Twisted Magnetic Van der Waals Bilayers: An Ideal Platform for Altermagnetism
papers.read_depth: journal metadata/abstract; arXiv model Eqs.1-3 and geometry read
papers.summary_zh: 通过翻层和相反转角保持交换反向磁层的面内二重旋转；单层对称性约束 d/g/i 波类型。适合作为公度几何和对称性检查的物理来源。
papers.implementation_scope: 公度格点几何必须另行构造并验证；通用整数超胞工具不等同复现文中 Slater–Koster 跃迁或 VOBr DFT。

papers.title: Bilayer stacking A-type altermagnet: A general approach to generating two-dimensional altermagnetism
papers.summary_zh: 对 A 型双层交错磁给出层群堆叠分类和可交换两层的操作。公度与交错磁是两个独立条件，生成超胞之后仍要核对磁序和层间对称性。
papers.implementation_scope: 理论分类指导几何约束；未提取该文完整材料跃迁参数。

papers.title: Valley polarization in twisted altermagnetism
papers.summary_zh: 层偏压使不同层的相反自旋谷错开，原文给出可忽略层间耦合的极限。已有日报实现应保留来源和近似标签，避免重新计作新模型。
papers.implementation_scope: T=0 解耦四带基准；任意转角的旋转色散不能自动解释为完整 moiré 折叠和散射。

papers.title: Sublayer-resolved altermagnetism in twisted antiferromagnetic bilayers with spin-layer coupling
papers.read_depth: journal metadata and abstract; full model not obtained
papers.summary_zh: MnSe 双层的六角翘曲色散与亚层相关 moiré 势共同产生 i 波劈裂；AA 与 AAᴿ 堆叠的对称机制不同。适合后续亚层投影和势相位约束基准。
papers.implementation_scope: 需先获取全文/补充中的系数与规范；本次不将摘要所述连续模型当成已复现。

papers.title: Ubiquitous van der Waals altermagnetism with sliding/moire ferroelectricity
papers.authors_source: arXiv v1 author order; journal author order not independently checked
papers.read_depth: arXiv metadata/abstract; journal DOI supplied by arXiv; journal fetch unavailable
papers.summary_zh: 滑移或扭转堆叠将铁电极化和自旋劈裂联系起来，可为层势与交换调制选题提供依据。应区分作者所称 pseudo-altermagnetism 与由旋转对称性补偿的交错磁。
papers.implementation_scope: 材料设计参照；尚无本次提取的完整电子跃迁参数。

papers.title: Moiré-induced altermagnetism from nonmagnetic constituents
papers.read_depth: abstract, mechanism/model and End Matter S6-S11 inspected
papers.summary_zh: 非磁方格层经结构弛豫、交替畴壁旋涡及电子相互作用产生 d/g 波。它要求弹性弛豫与自洽 Hartree–Fock，不能用预先指定的交换场代表自发磁序形成。
papers.implementation_scope: 研究路线；当前固定哈密顿量工具不覆盖完整自洽形成机制。

papers.title: Altermagnetism in twisted van der Waals homostructures
papers.read_depth: publisher search-indexed article metadata, abstract and source-data descriptions
papers.summary_zh: 正交 CrPS₄ 同质结构的磁光、Raman 与 DFT 证据构成实验参照。实验厚度和 90° 几何应明确记录，不能把小角连续模型能带当成这些光谱的直接复现。
papers.implementation_scope: 实验背景与材料选取；无本次新增的拟合电子模型。

papers.title: Altermagnetic Magnons in Twisted van der Waals Antiferromagnets
papers.read_depth: publisher metadata; PMC abstract and spin Hamiltonian section inspected
papers.summary_zh: 转角改变层内交换分布，在 CrPS₄/CrI₃ 产生交错磁磁振子劈裂。它适合未来独立自旋波分支；电子费米子 TB 的本征求解不能直接替代玻色 BdG 问题。
papers.implementation_scope: 玻色磁振子，非当前电子 TB 新预设。

papers.title: Twist-induced magnetic topological phase transition in stacked altermagnetic CrO
papers.read_depth: metadata/abstract and HTML searched; no complete electronic hopping table extracted
papers.summary_zh: 公度扭转 CrO 的磁性与拓扑相变给出通用动量处的 Weyl 点。建议后续导入可核验 Wannier 数据并做全 BZ 节点搜索；本次仅补充候选记录。
papers.implementation_scope: 材料 DFT/拓扑研究；当前通用几何与谐波不是该材料的复现。

papers.title: Direct observation of quadruple spin-texture locking in a 2D d-wave altermagnet
papers.read_depth: arXiv metadata and abstract only; HTML fulltext unavailable
papers.summary_zh: RbV₂Se₂O 自旋 STM/QPI 报告自旋纹理锁定，并将条纹归因于自旋密度波 moiré。它扩展了观察方向，但该 moiré 不是双层几何扭角，结论按预印本处理。
papers.implementation_scope: 实验候选；需完整散射/纹理模型，当前无可复用跃迁表。

papers.title: Relativistic Mott transition and high-order van Hove singularity in twisted double bilayer WSe2: Mean-field and functional renormalization group study
papers.read_depth: journal metadata; arXiv continuum Eqs.1-5 and TB fitting section inspected
papers.summary_zh: ABBA WSe₂ 的 Γ 谷四层连续模型可检验截断收敛、鞍点与拟合方法。保留为外围可复用基准；单粒子部分自旋简并，不能计成交错磁模型。
papers.implementation_scope: 复用既有日报非相互作用模型；不声称实现 Mott 相图或 fRG。
papers.equations: arXiv v2 Eqs.1-5; honeycomb TB fit Eq.6

papers.title: Nonrelativistic Spin-Momentum Coupling in Antiferromagnetic Twisted Bilayers
papers.read_depth: publisher abstract and primary fulltext opening inspected; full study already cited in prior local NiCl2 manuscript
papers.summary_zh: NiCl2转角双层的非相对论自旋动量耦合，为既有VASP算例的材料与对称性参照。
papers.implementation_scope: 本轮单轨道参数未拟合该文的DFT能带；继承本地固定结构计算的边界。

papers.title: Super-moiré spin textures in twisted two-dimensional antiferromagnets
papers.read_depth: publisher abstract and main introduction inspected; prior manuscript uses this as spin-texture comparison
papers.summary_zh: CrI3双双层中磁纹理尺度可超过几何莫尔周期，且转角趋势由多种磁相互作用竞争决定。
papers.implementation_scope: 用于区分几何周期与磁响应长度；当前固定磁序电子TB不复现平衡磁织构。
